about: Production procedures for the strategist, our summary of the docs above. value_base is the game's unitValue x grade modifier per unit; value_market adds the contraband markup (+35/+70/+100/+150 % at levels 1-4) before retail markup, events and haggling. yield is per batch as measured in the lab (lab: true) or computed from code. time counts store days (real-time steps take seconds; 'nights' are evaporator/printer nights). risk: contraband level of inputs/outputs, the crime a sale writes, and the failure modes that ruin a batch.

rules.buyers_refuse: junk and starch always; cut product for grade-2 buyers (worn-out spacer, upper-level hedonist); judged on the label until a scanner-carrying buyer exposes it (-4 faction rep if over-labelled)
rules.dont_cut_for_value: value per ml of active ingredient rises with purity for every product except Phanta; cut (with starch) only to stretch a cartel quota count or to keep Phanta below 75 %

temperature_windows.dream_extraction: set 45 C (40 <= T < 50); a 40 C target settles at 39.9 and does nothing; mush rots from 50, extract dies from 60
temperature_windows.nightmare_extraction: set 45 C; extract dies 5 %/s per degree above 50
temperature_windows.coffee_extraction: >= 50 C with alcohol (any heat is safe), >= 80 C with water (1/6 the yield)
temperature_windows.nomore: 50-55 C (fast) or 45-50 (half speed); lipobond boils above 55; alcohol must be <= 10 % of the mix
temperature_windows.phanta: 120-129 C (15 %/s); 110-119 is 6x slower; >= 130 destroys 2 %/s; a 1-module plate is fixed at 160 and ruins it
temperature_windows.lipobond: add below 55 C or it boils off before binding fat

machines: chem_finisher (4 modules; 3 only from a perfectly clean residue)

inputs.note: equal to the protein: 2 ml per cap

steps: Blend the caps into the pitcher (0 % loss at 4 modules).
Pour 4 mini alcohol bottles (ratio >= 5; ratio 1-2 gives more extract per ml of solvent if caps are cheap and evaporator time is short).
Heat to 45 C and hold 2 minutes (or heat on an unmodded plate, lift it off at 45 C and let it react on the shelf). Never leave it on the plate at night.
Add acid equal to the protein by dropper; wait a minute; neutralise leftover acid with base.
Pour through kotton fabric, then through the water filter.
Evaporate until dry (about 1 night per 300 ml of solvent: 4 nights here; a turbo booster adds a night).
Finisher on Dream Dust; press Output until it stops. Press only when a buyer or the cartel is due.
recipes.input_cost: 6 caps (138 at 23, or free from the cartel/own bay) + 2 common_chemical (100) + power

risk.sale_crime: DRUG_TRAFFICKING (BM buyers halve it; cartel clients 0)
failure: extract left on an unmodded plate overnight is destroyed

inputs.count: count x (req+10)/100 x 2 ml / 11 ml per cap

steps: Weekly visit is on days 8, 15, 22... (day % 7 == 1). Terms start at 10 units at 40 % and grow +5 units and +5 % (cap 70 %) each week.
Aim the batch mean at exactly required + 10 (rep = +(mean - req) up to that, only a quarter above it) and deliver at least the count: rep + the whole count.
Make extract as for lab pure, then dilute with starch (or skip the water filter: kotton-only gives ~62 %) to the target; mix extracts of known purity by volume.
Put every dream dust you want delivered on the counters; the handler takes all of it, surplus included. Keep sale stock off the counters (smuggler's bay).

yield.note: week 1 needs 10 ml of extract (one cap) at 50 %

recipes.time: same pipeline; deliver on the weekly day

expected_value_batch.cash: 150 stipend (+4 x cartel rep with Increased Stipend), 3 caps + 1 common_chemical, + 1 chem_module when count and purity both pass

failure: short count: -4 rep per missing unit
risk.exit: authorized exit at rep 100 only starts it; the threshold rises 25 per weekly visit to 200

machines: chem_finisher (4 modules; 3 only from a perfectly clean residue)

inputs.note: equal to protein; 8 ml per bean

steps: Blend the beans into the pitcher.
Add one mini alcohol bottle per ~3 beans (alcohol >= 1.3x the mush gives the full 75 %).
Heat to >= 50 C for 2 minutes (caffeine never degrades).
Let it cool below 55 C, then add lipobond (1 per 8 fat) and acid equal to the protein; wait 90 s; neutralise leftover acid with base.
Water filter; evaporate (1 night).
Finisher on Caffeine Pill (5 ml per pill).
recipes.input_cost: 3 beans (84, or grown: 8 beans per 3 nights per bay) + about half a common_chemical

risk.sale_crime: none; bad legal product feeds FRAUD/ENDANGERMENT (1 point per 300 of price)
failure: lipobond added hot boils away: pharma 95.7 % instead of lab pure

steps: Pour the precursor into the pitcher; add acid at a quarter of the stabiliser; wait a minute (stabiliser goes to debris).
Neutralise the leftover acid with base; water filter.
Add reducing agent at 0.75 x the methylol.
Heat to 120-129 C (4-module plate at 128 C: done in ~40 s). Never use a 1-module plate (fixed 160 C).
Finisher on Phanta Pill (0.5 ml each). Keep the product below 75 % (cut with starch if needed): 75 %+ is toxic, 100 % lethal.

yield.per_input: ~12 ml Phanta per precursor bottle; ~80 pills per restricted pack

recipes.input_cost: restricted_chemical 100 per 2 bottles + a little common_chemical

failure: toxic at >= 75 % purity: -7 rep and refund demands; lethal at 100 %: -17 rep
plate below 120 C: 6x slower; >= 130 C destroys it

steps: Start from dried dream extract (alcohol must be <= 10 % of the mix); add water, reducing agent 1:1, lipobond >= 1/4 of the extract.
Hold 52 C for a minute (60 % of the extract becomes nomore, 40 % debris).
Filter, evaporate water and lipobond, finisher (4 ml per injector).

risk.note: worth less than the 20 lab-pure dream dusts the same extract makes (840 base) but legal

steps: As dream dust, holding 45 C strictly (never 50+), 4 ml per unit.
Seat the chip and metal module, load 3 ingots (any purity), power; 5 nights.
Chip + metal module, 2 ingots; 5 nights.
Chip, 5 scrap + 2 plastic; 4 nights.
Chip, 4 scrap + 1 plastic; 4 nights.
Chip, 3 scrap + 1 plastic; 3 nights.
